endpoint: b09 historical native TRAIN only, nested first 256/1024/4096 parents in shared predeclared order. Development next 512, audit final 512 explicitly unopened until public lock and release. Equal weight to each parent and each of 1000 fixed origins (all even coordinates 0,2,...,18 per axis); uniform J = -z,+z,-y,+y,-x,+x. 2x2x2 ternary little-endian tile; microscopic 2x2 face at normal coordinate -2 or +3, one unobserved layer. Face words little-endian in lexicographic tangential order. All six directions used. One sample is one face, not a joint six-face label.
network: 16 A/B site indicators, dense width 32 tanh, four softmax logits. On deployment take hard argmax. No encoder is told J. Identical paired random parameter initialization per seed (2101,2102,2103) for all arms and rungs; no stochastic hardening, temperature tricks, or entropy penalties. Adam ascent 0.005 encoder; sampled critic Adam 0.01. No tuning on development. All three seeds at all data rungs.
arms: Direct: exactly sum soft conditional finite-channel I(H;Y|J) on unsmoothed fit empirical (V,J,Y). Contrastive: same q(h|v) analytically averages H in sampled 16-way InfoNCE; independent positives uniform over fit parent, origin,J; 15 independent with-replacement negative Y drawn from fit directional marginal P(Y|J), no cross-direction or same-parent restriction. Learned saturated score s[h,j,y], starts zero. Effective minibatch 1024 positives; report exact full fit soft MI separately, never use sampled objective as deployed performance. Teacher: per-rung independently refit hard Lloyd 4-code on fit-only channel, one geometry-defined tetrahedral A-dipole initialization, marginal backoff one per V,J; stop unchanged or 256 sweeps. Cross-entropy distill that map on fit V frequencies. Historical 0.025972-bit feasible result is contextual reference only; it used overlapping TRAIN parents so do not distill its pooled labels or select a teacher on its heldout similarities. This is not a literal replication of that pooled code.
depth: Checkpoints 0, 640, 1280, 2560 (1x/2x/4x); run capped 5120 update extension (8x) for every arm to avoid asymmetric stopping if time permits; three-hour single-thread CPU wall cap from first training. Primary latest common largest-rung checkpoint irrespective of direction; no checkpoint or seed cherry-picking. For each checkpoint fit and dev exact hard MI diagnostics, soft MI, hard entropy, paired proper scores; every 64 updates log training objective/gradient norms and estimate minibatch gradient noise at checkpoints. Direct/distill gradients deterministic (zero minibatch noise). Plateau threshold absolute mean 4x->8x dev hard score change <0.0001 nat/face per arm; a rising no-gain result is finite-compute, not a ceiling.
evaluation: Primary hard score = held-apart parent average log p(Y|hard H,J)/p(Y|J) in NAT per face. Fit and development proper scores first use identical decoder rule fitted on fit counts: fixed half-count per cell for direction-only baseline; conditional decoder adds 81 pseudo-faces per (h,j) in this baseline distribution. In addition refit each frozen hard map's decoder on development parents only, use it for the primary audit; fit-calibrated scores retained as sensitivity. No audit V/Y/decoders used in training or selection. Report train-dev predictive optimism by matched maps; exact sparse sample MI diagnostics not validation evidence. Seed average within parent for paired direct-minus-contrastive, separately report seed scatter and small-n Student t intervals across seed mean differences. Parent-cluster 95% paired intervals conditional on the three trained seeds; seed uncertainty conditional on these parents; not a joint generalization guarantee. Practical threshold +0.001 nat/face. A positive material advantage requires paired audit lower endpoint above margin; seeds check reproducibility independently. Distilled agreement and teacher score distinguish feasibility from optimization, not global optimum. Plot all rung/seed differences and full checkpoint learning curves. Independent planted recoverable four-state control and analytic vs central difference gradients before physical inference.
